title: Global Well-Posedness for Planar Compressible Magnetohydrodynamics with Degenerate Viscosity on Unbounded Domains
summary: The one-dimensional planar compressible magnetohydrodynamic system is studied on unbounded domains. The longitudinal viscosity obeys a power law of the specific volume, which permits it to degenerate as the density approaches vacuum, and the heat conductivity follows a power law of the temperature. For any fixed non-negative exponent in the heat conductivity term, the existence and uniqueness of global strong solutions are established for arbitrarily large initial data, provided that the positive exponent for viscosity is sufficiently small.
